step5.title: Preferences
step5.subtitle: Pick what LineCatch does for you. You can change this anytime in Settings.
step5.autotext_desc: When a client's call goes unanswered, LineCatch sends them a booking link automatically.
step5.wednesday_desc: Only on Wednesdays at noon: the first Wednesday 2–3 weeks after a cut, then every 3 weeks until they book or reply STOP.

step5.sticker_desc: We'll ship it to your shop. You can also order one later in Settings.

step6.title: Your portfolio

forward.how: Keep your own number. Turn this on once from your phone: calls you don’t get to go to LineCatch, and the caller gets a text with your booking link.
forward.direct_how: Give clients this number. It rings your cell for 15 seconds; if you don’t pick up, the caller gets a text with your booking link.
forward.pending_title: Your LineCatch number is almost ready
forward.pending_body: You get your own LineCatch number as soon as these are done:
forward.pending_soon: Everything’s set. Your number will appear here in a moment.
forward.step_portfolio: Add a photo to your portfolio
forward.which_carrier: Which carrier is your cell on?
forward.turn_on_hint: Opens your phone with the code typed in. Press call, wait for the confirmation, done.
forward.what_10s: Rings 10 seconds, then the caller gets a text
forward.what_decline: Tap Decline and they get the text right away
forward.what_off: Phone off or no signal: they still get it
forward.what_unanswered: Calls you don’t answer: the caller gets a text
forward.if_error: Got an error? Dial this instead:
forward.other_title: Your carrier sets this up in phone settings or by phone. Forward to {number}:
forward.other_android_steps: Phone app → ⋮ (top right) → Settings → Calls or Supplementary services → Call forwarding → set “When unanswered” and “When busy” to {number}.
forward.other_iphone: iPhone (or if Android has no such menu)
forward.other_iphone_steps: Call your carrier (dial 611) and say: “Please forward my calls to {number} when I don’t answer or I’m busy.”
forward.other_avoid: Don’t use “Forward all calls”: your phone would stop ringing.
forward.working: Working. Last missed call came in {when}.
forward.test_it: Test it: have someone call your cell and let it ring. They should get the text within a minute.
